name: mold
role: the extension's linker, unconditionally: setup.py links with -fuse-ld=mold and refuses to build if it is absent or mismatched -- no fallback to ld.bfd/ld.gold, the constitution's NO FALLBACKS AT THE ATOM rule extended to the toolchain: a build must not differ by which linker happened to be installed.
same_pin_as: Dockerfile's MOLD_VERSION/MOLD_SHA256 ARGs -- ONE pin, read here so setup.py's host-side gate and the container's apt-unavailable install agree on the same artifact rather than restating the version in two places.
why_not_gated_like_ptxas: mold links the extension; it does not touch codegen (tools/build_flags.py's module docstring: link flags are explicitly not part of the ratified, codegen-affecting flag list a ptxas swap can move). So its version is RECORDED in tools/ratify.py's manifest toolchain.mold block for provenance -- which linker actually produced the shipped .so -- and is not part of the SASS-body ratchet the way ptxas is; it is still a HARD gate at build time (this pin, not a range) because the constitution refuses a mechanism that silently differs by which binary happened to be on a given host's PATH, which is a build-reproducibility question, not a codegen-fidelity one.
